title: What Road Travel in Tanzania Is Really Like
excerpt: What is road travel in Tanzania really like? Distances, road conditions and why a good driver-guide matters.
body:
## Distances

Distances on the map can be misleading. Gravel roads and speed limits make travel slower.

## Roads

Main roads are mostly tarred. Park roads are gravel and can be bumpy and dusty, or muddy in the rains.

## Speed limits and checks

Speed cameras and police checks are common.

## Self-drive

Possible, but challenging. Most travellers choose a driver-guide.

## Driver-guide

A professional driver-guide knows the roads and the wildlife.

See [long drives on safari](/blog/long-drives-on-safari/) or [plan your trip](/travel-proposal/).
